goal_description: Order one Black Bean Crunchwrap Supreme customized with Fiesta Strips and Seasoned Rice, and one {{side_item}}. Use the location {{location}} when asked for a city/store. The Black Bean Crunchwrap Supreme is in the SPECIALTIES menu category, not Veggie Cravings, so go to Specialties first. When asked to choose a pickup method, select Drive-Thru if it's available; if only In-Store pickup is offered, select that instead. When asked when you'd like your order, select 'Now'. When asked to confirm the store/pickup selection, select 'Finish'. Reach the cart / order review screen. NEVER enter payment info or complete the purchase. For the second item, add the item whose name is EXACTLY {{side_item}}. Do NOT pick a different variant with a similar name (e.g. 'Diablo Ranch Steak Nacho Fries' is a DIFFERENT product from 'Large Nacho Fries'). The exact item may appear further down the page.

inputs.name: location
inputs.description: City and state used to find a nearby store

inputs.name: side_item
inputs.description: Exact menu name of the second item to add

inputs.name: substitute_item
inputs.description: Optional item to use if side_item is unavailable. If omitted, an unavailable side_item is reported as a business outcome instead of substituting.

outputs.name: order_total
outputs.description: Subtotal shown in the bag/review screen, e.g. '$11.47'

steps.description: I need to start the order process to proceed with the goal of ordering the specified items.
I need to enter the location 'San Jose, CA' to find nearby Taco Bell stores.
I need to submit the location search for 'San Jose, CA' by clicking the search button.
The page shows 'Finding Stores...' loading indicator, so I need to wait for the store results to appear
I need to select the first available store from the search results to proceed with ordering.
Drive-Thru is not available at this location, so I need to select In-Store pickup as instructed in the goal.
I need to select 'Now' for the pickup time as instructed in the goal.
I need to confirm the store and pickup selection by clicking 'Finish' as instructed in the goal.
I need to navigate to the Specialties category to find the Black Bean Crunchwrap Supreme as instructed in the goal.
I need to customize the Black Bean Crunchwrap Supreme to add Fiesta Strips and Seasoned Rice as specified in the goal.
I need to add Seasoned Rice as a customization to the Black Bean Crunchwrap Supreme.
I need to add Fiesta Strips as the second customization to the Black Bean Crunchwrap Supreme
Both customizations (Seasoned Rice and Fiesta Strips) have been added to the Black Bean Crunchwrap Supreme, so I need to add this item to the cart.
I need to close the cart dialog to continue browsing the menu and add the Large Nacho Fries as the second item.
I found the exact 'Large Nacho Fries' item on the page and need to add it to the order to complete the goal.

fallback.condition: side_item unavailable and caller supplied substitute_item

on_missing.message: '{{side_item}}' is not available on this store's menu.

steps.description: I need to close the cart dialog to reach the order review screen and verify that both items have been successfully added.

I have successfully added both items (Black Bean Crunchwrap Supreme with customizations and Large Nacho Fries) to the cart, and now I need to navigate to the cart/order review screen to complete the goal.

checkpoint.description: The bag / order review panel is open

outcome_signatures.message: The requested item is sold out at this store.
